title: Mountain Bike: Maple's helmet
kaylee: Maple rides in a real kids' bike helmet: a white rim and stripe, vent slots, a pink peak, a heart on each side and a chin strap.

pictures.title: From the front
pictures.caption: The peak sits on the rim above her eyes, not across her forehead

pictures.title: From behind (how you see her on the trail)
pictures.caption: Stripe, vents and a heart, so it reads as a helmet from the riding camera
